title: The worst marketing mistake 90% of business owners make
description: The worst marketing mistake 90% of business owners make
transcript: In the marketing, in the ads and in the funnel, you actually wanna make it stupid simple. So you don't wanna say, we're gonna do coaching consulting, you're gonna get access all these calls. You just wanna be like, hey, if you're this person, we're gonna place a virtual assistant in your business and they don't grow it, then you don't pay. So you're not gonna go into, there's access of coaching calls and slack and we're gonna help you because the truth is, it's too much information for somebody to understand who you are and they really just wanna put you in a box. Okay, is it a coach or is it a placement agency, a recruitment agency? Like I said earlier, you have three to five seconds, so don't blow it trying to make yourself sound super unique. That's not what the marketing is for.
